==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am having a nice time at a superhero's house. Suddenly the front door starts to open. The host tells me to hide.

I race up stairs. I hide in a massive junk room. Small robot guards activate and face me.

I try to keep the guards off me, while remaining quiet. I grab a saw blade and slice the robots in half. I quickly retreat under a blanket.
